as_told.title: Temple with cult symbology on St. James Island
as_told.place_text: Little St. James Island, US Virgin Islands

plain: The financier Jeffrey Epstein, the story goes, built a temple to Poseidon, the Greek sea god, on his private island, Little St. James, and laid out a maze at his New Mexico property, Zorro Ranch, in the shape of the lost city of Atlantis. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it, passing on what an online commentator called Dark Journalist found. He says Poseidon was Epstein's "patron deity," and that "on Zoro Ranch, where the breeding program was, he had a labyrinth in the shape of the ground plan of Atlantis." That plan is the one the Greek philosopher Plato describes in his dialogues Timaeus and Critias. Michels, in his own framing in another episode, is vaguer: on the island Epstein "built a temple with a cult symbology." He does not name Poseidon or mention the ranch. They tell it because, if true, it would point to some private belief system behind Epstein's world.
